paragraphs.text: On work and AI, moneycontrol.com reports that Block announced a second round of job cuts in 2026. Phoronix.com says SUSE is laying off 10% of its workforce due to AI and automation. Fortune.com says Goldman says AI layoffs are leaving a 'long-lasting' scar. Gadgetreview.com says companies are rehiring humans after AI layoffs, while scottdiesel.dev calls AI layoffs "the Greatest Lie of the Decade". Wral.com says a hiring rebound is expected in new US jobs data.
